gate: mean voluntary lcp calls on the fastmcp cases >= 1.0/run -> outcome A
reference: Phase 2 lcp arm (phase2-mcp-iter2), same cases: fastmcp 0.0 calls 1/12 pass; cyhole 2.3-3.6 calls 2-4/12 pass
note: tool_calls in metrics counts every tool_use block including the CLI's built-in ToolSearch; gate evaluated on mcp__lcp__* calls only (tool_call_details), which is the stricter reading. An earlier same-day run of this experiment accidentally executed against the pre-Phase-2 V1 server (lcp is installed editable and the branch was mis-based); those runs were discarded (branch backup/phase-2b-v1-results) and this is the valid V2 measurement.
